newsitem.title: UK: Marks & Spencer to enter OTC drugs mkt - paper.
newsitem.headline: Marks & Spencer to enter OTC drugs mkt - paper.

text.p: The UK's leading retailer Marks and Spencer Plc plans to enter the over-the-counter (OTC) pharmaceuticals market with a range of products branded under its St Michael name, pitching at a 1.2 billion stg market, said a report in The Times on Monday.

The products are expected to range from vitamins to paracetamol as well as general health products and will pitch M&S directly against traditional drug-store retail chains including the market leader Boots Co Plc.
The range could be in M&S stores by January but the group is not expected to deal with prescription drugs.
Its move into the OTC market follows the recent foray by supermarket retailer ASDA Group Plc, which started a price-war in the pharmaceuticals market for certain OTC products.
